006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008/**
009 * Defines how repeated instances are grouped in XML representations.
010 */
011public enum XmlGroupAsBehavior {
012  /**
013   * In XML, child element instances will be wrapped by a grouping element.
014   */
015  GROUPED,
016  /**
017   * In XML, child element instances will exist in an unwrapped form.
018   */
019  UNGROUPED
020}
